candidate.title: SHAPE-MaP
candidate.scope: The 1M7/Mn2+ SHAPE-MaP overview in the middle row of the assigned Illumina crop. Two vertically arranged folded-RNA examples retain separate material routes through SHAPE adduct formation, mutational cDNA synthesis, library preparation/sequencing and mutation counting to the shared terminal caption Profile. The top example has a small side bulge; the bottom has a larger side stem-loop. They are illustrative RNA examples, not labeled treatment/control alternatives or established conformers of the same sequence. The left yellow-highlighted RNA drawings and expanded method name identify the assay; no transfer arrow connects those descriptive icons to the input examples. Neighboring CIRS-seq and Structure-Seq/DMS-Seq rows are outside this card target. The verified collection page has the SHAPE-MaP heading and matching schematic labels. Its other workflows and similar-method listings do not expand this schematic. No unshown control preparation, library subtype or downstream structure-modeling workflow is reconstructed.
